description: User writes Slovak; decision not to use Redis, in-memory cache instead.

record.prompt: produkty sa načítavajú pomaly. nechcem kvôli tomu pridávať Redis, appka beží len na jednom serveri a nechcem ďalšiu službu, ktorú treba spravovať. stačí cache v pamäti
record.assistant: Done. I added an in-process LRU cache (functools.lru_cache, 2048 entries) around the product lookup instead of Redis. With a single server instance there is no cache-consistency problem between processes, and we avoid operating another service. Caveat: the cache is lost on restart and isn't invalidated when a product is edited; for now product edits are rare, but we should clear it on admin updates later.
